scripts.build:sidecar: pnpm --filter @open-vera/core build && pnpm --filter @open-vera/openvera build && pnpm --filter @vera/partner-sidecar build && node scripts/stage-sidecar.mjs
scripts.tauri:dev: PARTNER_BUNDLE_NODE=0 pnpm run build:sidecar && tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build:bundled: PARTNER_BUNDLE_NODE=1 pnpm run build:sidecar && PARTNER_BUNDLE_NODE=1 tauri build --bundles app && node scripts/fix-macos-icon.mjs && node scripts/post-build-release.mjs bundled
scripts.tauri:build:system: PARTNER_BUNDLE_NODE=0 pnpm run build:sidecar && PARTNER_BUNDLE_NODE=0 tauri build --bundles app && node scripts/fix-macos-icon.mjs && node scripts/post-build-release.mjs system
scripts.tauri:build:all: pnpm run tauri:build:bundled && pnpm run tauri:build:system
